title: Elevated hantavirus activity in Baden-Württemberg
snippet: Regional health authorities report above-average number of hantavirus inquiries from clinics in the Black Forest region following a beech mast year.

title: RKI warns of upcoming hantavirus season 2025
snippet: The Robert Koch Institute publishes an early-warning bulletin noting that bank vole populations in several German states are at elevated levels, suggesting potential for increased human cases.

title: German media: hantavirus cases rising earlier than usual
snippet: Several German news outlets report that clinicians in Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg are already seeing hantavirus patients in March, earlier than the typical May–August peak.

title: THL seasonal alert: Puumala virus risk elevated in 2025
snippet: Finland's THL issues a seasonal alert noting increased Clethrionomys glareolus (bank vole) trapping counts, a known predictor of Puumala hantavirus season intensity.
sourceOrg: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)

title: Finnish study links mast year to 2025 hantavirus outlook
snippet: Researchers at the University of Helsinki publish a preprint suggesting that 2024 beech/spruce mast events will drive elevated Puumala hantavirus transmission in Finland through summer 2025.

title: Sweden: increased hantavirus hospitalizations reported in Norrland
snippet: Swedish public health authorities note a cluster of hantavirus-related hospitalizations in Northern Sweden (Norrland), with 7 confirmed and several suspected additional cases under investigation.

title: SVT: hantavirus in Sweden — what you need to know
snippet: SVT (Swedish public broadcaster) publishes an explainer about hantavirus risks as spring approaches, including an interview with an infectious disease specialist about recent case trends.

title: PZH bulletin: hantavirus cases increasing in Silesia
snippet: Polish national health bulletin reports rising case counts in the Silesian region, consistent with an active Puumala hantavirus season. Forestry workers and outdoor recreationists advised to take precautions.
sourceOrg: National Institute of Public Health Poland (PZH)

title: Polish news: first hantavirus fatality of 2025 reported
snippet: Polish news agency PAP reports the first confirmed hantavirus-related fatality of 2025 in the Lower Silesia region. Authorities confirm the case and urge awareness.

title: Rospotrebnadzor: HFRS cases rising in Bashkortostan
snippet: Russia's federal consumer protection agency reports a notable increase in hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) cases in Bashkortostan and the Volga-Ural region.

title: WHO EURO: Russia HFRS seasonal outlook 2025
snippet: WHO European Regional Office includes Russia's HFRS situation in its spring communicable disease outlook, noting continued endemicity and seasonal peak expected May–September.

title: Belarus health ministry: HFRS warning for Grodno region
snippet: Belarusian health authorities issue a public warning about elevated HFRS risk in the Grodno and Brest regions following reports of increased rodent activity.
sourceOrg: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Belarus

title: HZJZ Croatia: hantavirus season starts ahead of schedule
snippet: Croatian Institute of Public Health reports the first 3 confirmed hantavirus cases of 2025 by April, ahead of the typical June start of peak season.

title: Bosnia: hantavirus cases in Una-Sana and Zenica regions
snippet: Bosnian public health officials confirm a small cluster of hantavirus cases near the Una-Sana canton, linked to forestry work. Multiple suspect cases are under laboratory evaluation.

title: Serbia: HFRS cases reported in Vojvodina
snippet: Serbian Institute of Public Health reports several HFRS cases in Vojvodina, consistent with seasonal patterns. Citizens in rural areas are reminded to avoid contact with rodents.
sourceOrg: Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'

title: FHI Norway: no confirmed cases but increased queries
snippet: Norway's Institute of Public Health (FHI) notes increased clinician queries about hantavirus differential diagnosis, without confirmed cases to date in 2025. Seasonal awareness recommended.

title: Norwegian media: neighboring countries see early hantavirus activity
snippet: NRK (Norwegian Broadcasting Corporation) covers early hantavirus cases in Sweden and Finland, noting Norwegian health authorities are monitoring the situation ahead of the Norwegian outdoor season.

title: ECDC: European hantavirus season early-warning assessment
snippet: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) publishes a risk assessment noting several central European countries entering potential high-risk years for hantavirus based on rodent monitoring data.
sourceOrg: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)

title: France: hantavirus cases in Ardennes department
snippet: French health surveillance (Santé Publique France) reports a small cluster of Puumala hantavirus cases in the Ardennes department, consistent with activity in neighboring Belgium and Germany.

title: Belgium: Sciensano reports hantavirus cases in Wallonia
snippet: Sciensano (Belgian public health institute) reports an uptick in hantavirus cases in the Wallonia region, particularly the Ardennes. Similar patterns noted in France and Germany.

title: RIVM Netherlands: hantavirus risk bulletin spring 2025
snippet: Dutch RIVM issues its spring hantavirus bulletin noting low but present risk, primarily for individuals working with or near rodents, especially in the south and east of the Netherlands.
sourceOrg: RIVM (National Institute for Public Health and the Environment, Netherlands)

title: Austria: hantavirus cases in Styria and Carinthia
snippet: Austrian Gesundheit Österreich reports several hantavirus cases in the mountainous southern states. Cases are consistent with Puumala hantavirus, linked to forestry and outdoor activities.

title: Czech SZÚ: hantavirus monitoring update Q1 2025
snippet: The National Institute of Public Health (SZÚ) in Prague reports continued hantavirus monitoring, with several laboratory-confirmed cases in Q1 2025 from the Bohemian Forest and Vysočina regions.
sourceOrg: National Institute of Public Health Czech Republic (SZÚ)

title: Slovakia: ÚVZSR reports seasonal hantavirus uptick
snippet: Slovakia's Public Health Authority (ÚVZSR) notes a seasonal increase in hantavirus seropositivity among rodents sampled in forestry areas, raising concern for spring 2025 transmission season.

title: Hungary ÁNTSZ: hantavirus cases in Northern Hungary
snippet: Hungarian National Public Health Center notes several hantavirus cases in Northern Hungary (Bükk, Mátra mountain areas) in early 2025, consistent with the endemic pattern.

title: Slovenia NIJZ: hantavirus cases in Kočevje region
snippet: Slovenian public health institute reports hantavirus cases in the Kočevje region (known for high bank vole density). Forestry workers are a key risk group.
sourceOrg: National Institute of Public Health Slovenia (NIJZ)

title: Romania: hantavirus cases detected in Transylvania
snippet: Romanian health officials report several confirmed hantavirus cases in Transylvania and Carpathian mountain areas. WHO EURO is monitoring the situation.

title: Bulgaria: HFRS cases detected in Rhodope region
snippet: Bulgarian National Center of Infectious and Parasitic Diseases confirms several HFRS cases linked to the Rhodope mountain region during winter, with laboratory confirmation pending for some.
sourceOrg: National Center of Infectious and Parasitic Diseases (Bulgaria)

title: Ukraine: limited hantavirus surveillance data available
snippet: International health observers note that hantavirus surveillance in Ukraine is severely limited due to ongoing conflict. Historical data suggests endemic transmission particularly in western and forested regions.

title: Lithuania: NVSPL reports hantavirus cases in Aukštaitija
snippet: Lithuanian National Public Health Center notes hantavirus cases in the Aukštaitija region (northeastern Lithuania), an area with significant deciduous forest coverage and bank vole habitat.
sourceOrg: National Public Health Centre under the Ministry of Health Lithuania (NVSC)

title: Latvia: CDPC warns of hantavirus risk in Vidzeme
snippet: Latvia's Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (CDPC) issues a public health notice about hantavirus risk in the Vidzeme region, recommending precautions for forestry workers and mushroom pickers.
sourceOrg: Centre for Disease Prevention and Control Latvia (CDPC)

title: Estonia: Terviseamet notices hantavirus cases in southeastern Estonia
snippet: Estonian Health Board (Terviseamet) confirms early hantavirus cases in 2025, primarily from southeastern Estonia, consistent with endemic transmission via Puumala virus.

title: Yle: hantavirus cases in Finland highest in 5 years
snippet: Finnish public broadcaster Yle reports that April 2025 hantavirus case count is the highest for an April in five years, with experts attributing this to a peak bank vole cycle year.

title: Swedish Doctors: hantavirus differential diagnosis guide updated
snippet: Swedish Society of Infectious Diseases publishes an updated clinical guide for hantavirus differential diagnosis ahead of the 2025 season, citing new rapid diagnostic tools.

title: Study: climate factors predicted elevated 2025 hantavirus risk in Germany
snippet: A peer-reviewed study in Emerging Infectious Diseases modeled climate and rodent population dynamics to forecast elevated hantavirus risk for Germany and Central Europe in 2025.

title: Interfax: Bashkortostan hantavirus emergency declared
snippet: Russian news agency Interfax reports that the Bashkortostan regional government has declared a local public health emergency following a surge in HFRS cases in April 2025.

title: Croatia: hantavirus cluster in Karlovac county
snippet: Three related hantavirus cases in Karlovac county (central Croatia) spark an investigation by HZJZ. Epidemiologists are assessing potential common exposure in a forestry area.

title: Bavaria: hantavirus warning for May Day holiday hikers
snippet: Bavarian State Office for Health and Food Safety (LGL) issues a public warning for hikers and campers celebrating May Day in forested areas, advising precautions to avoid rodent contact.

title: Norway: FHI updates hantavirus travel health advice
snippet: FHI updates its travel health page noting increased activity in nearby countries (Finland, Sweden, Germany) and recommends standard precautions for Norwegians traveling to affected regions.

title: Poland: hantavirus cases in Lublin region woodland workers
snippet: Polish health authorities investigate cases among forestry workers in the Lublin region. Three workers hospitalized with suspected hantavirus infection; laboratory results pending.
sourceOrg: National Institute of Public Health Poland (PZH)

title: France: hantavirus awareness campaign launched in forest regions
snippet: Santé Publique France launches an awareness campaign in the Grand Est and Hauts-de-France regions following an above-average winter with high bank vole counts in monitoring traps.

title: Austrian media: hantavirus risk elevated for 2025 hiking season
snippet: Der Standard reports that Austrian health officials are expecting an elevated hantavirus season in 2025 based on rodent population monitoring in the Alps and Styria.

title: Switzerland: FOPH notes cross-border hantavirus signal
snippet: Switzerland's Federal Office of Public Health (FOPH/BAG) notes hantavirus cases in neighboring Germany and Austria and advises Swiss clinicians about differential diagnosis in the upcoming season.
sourceOrg: Federal Office of Public Health Switzerland (FOPH/BAG)

title: Denmark SSI: cross-border hantavirus monitoring bulletin
snippet: Statens Serum Institut (SSI) in Denmark publishes a monitoring update noting hantavirus activity in neighboring countries (Germany, Sweden) and reporting one suspected case in Denmark under investigation.

title: Greece EODY: HFRS cases in northern Greece
snippet: Greek health authority EODY reports a small cluster of hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) cases in Thrace and Macedonia regions, consistent with Dobrava hantavirus.

title: Serbia: rising HFRS trend in Central Serbia
snippet: HFRS cases in central Serbia show an early-season increase with 8 cases reported in April 2025. Authorities note rodent population boom following mild winter.
sourceOrg: Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'

title: CDC: hantavirus pulmonary syndrome case in Arizona
snippet: CDC reports a confirmed hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) case in Arizona. The patient had potential exposure to deer mice in a rural setting. No evidence of person-to-person transmission.
sourceOrg: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

title: Argentina: hantavirus cluster in Río Negro province
snippet: Argentine health ministry reports a cluster of hantavirus cases in Río Negro province (Patagonia). Three cases confirmed; contact tracing underway. No person-to-person transmission confirmed.

title: WHO Europe: Finland Puumala hantavirus situation report
snippet: WHO European Regional Office publishes a situation report on the Puumala hantavirus outbreak in Finland, noting that 2025 case counts by May 1 have already exceeded the 5-year average for the full Q1+Q2 period.

title: ECDC Rapid Risk Assessment: hantavirus in Central Europe 2025
snippet: ECDC publishes a rapid risk assessment for hantavirus in central Europe, noting Germany as a high-burden country in 2025. Risk to general public remains low; elevated risk for those with rodent exposure.
sourceOrg: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)

title: ProMED: Norway hantavirus – no cases but regional risk elevated
snippet: ProMED-mail posts a brief noting that although Norway has not reported confirmed cases in 2025, the regional situation (Finland, Sweden, Germany) suggests elevated context. FHI is monitoring.

title: Sweden: regional hantavirus alert for Dalarna county
snippet: Dalarna county health authority issues a local alert following 4 confirmed hantavirus cases in April. Outdoor activity guidance updated for spring/summer season.

title: Poland: hantavirus media coverage intensifies
snippet: Multiple Polish news outlets (Gazeta Wyborcza, TVN24) report on the rising hantavirus case count in Poland, with health experts urging caution in forested areas during spring activities.

title: Russia: HFRS cases rising in Udmurtia region
snippet: Rospotrebnadzor reports additional HFRS cases in the Udmurtia Republic, following the Bashkortostan cluster. Western Russia appears to be in an active HFRS season.

title: Belarus: HFRS cases reported in Vitebsk region
snippet: Belarusian health ministry reports new HFRS cases in the Vitebsk region, near the border with Russia and Lithuania. Seasonal trend consistent with prior years but slightly elevated.
sourceOrg: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Belarus

title: RKI 2026: hantavirus season begins in Baden-Württemberg and Bavaria
snippet: Robert Koch Institute 2026 early-season bulletin confirms first cases in southern Germany and notes rodent monitoring indicates another active year ahead.

title: THL 2026 spring alert: Puumala hantavirus activity rising
snippet: Finnish THL reports early hantavirus cases ahead of the typical June–August peak. Bank vole populations remain elevated following 2025 mast year.
sourceOrg: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)

title: Sweden: Dalarna and Jämtland counties report early hantavirus cases
snippet: Folkhälsomyndigheten announces early hantavirus season activity in central and northern Sweden, citing multiple confirmed hospitalizations in April 2026.

title: FHI Norway 2026: increased clinician queries, monitoring ongoing
snippet: Norway's FHI notes elevated clinician inquiries about hantavirus in April 2026, consistent with activity in neighboring countries. No confirmed Norwegian cases reported yet.

title: Poland PZH: seasonal hantavirus alert for spring 2026
snippet: Polish PZH issues spring 2026 hantavirus alert, noting that early case counts are consistent with an active transmission season in forested regions.
sourceOrg: National Institute of Public Health Poland (PZH)

title: Russia: HFRS cases rising in Volga-Ural region for 2026
snippet: Rospotrebnadzor reports the 2026 HFRS season has begun in earnest across the Volga-Ural region. April case counts tracking above 2025 levels.

title: ECDC 2026: Central Europe hantavirus early-season rapid assessment
snippet: ECDC publishes a rapid risk assessment noting Germany, Finland, and Sweden as high-activity countries entering the 2026 hantavirus season. Risk to general public remains low; elevated for rodent-exposed individuals.
sourceOrg: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)

title: Croatia: HZJZ reports early hantavirus cases in Karlovac and Lika
snippet: Croatian public health institute reports first hantavirus cases of 2026, earlier than the typical June start. Cases concentrated in forested areas of Karlovac and Lika counties.

title: NRK: Neighboring countries active with hantavirus — what does it mean for Norway?
snippet: NRK publishes an explainer as Finland and Sweden report active 2026 hantavirus seasons. Norwegian health experts note no current confirmed Norwegian cases but advise standard precautions.

title: Belarus: seasonal HFRS warning issued for Grodno and Vitebsk
snippet: Belarusian Ministry of Health issues a 2026 spring HFRS advisory, noting elevated risk in western and northern regions. Rodent populations remain high following mild winters.
sourceOrg: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Belarus
